vt1019070.title: Olympus OM-System G.Zuiko Auto-W 28mm f/3.5 MF Wide Angle Prime Lens OM Mount
vt1019070.packing: Carefully packed with protective cushioning and shipped from Japan with tracking.
vt1019070.details: Olympus OM-System G.Zuiko Auto-W 28mm f/3.5 manual focus wide-angle prime lens in the Olympus OM mount. Condition: age-related scuffs and small scratches, with signs of use mainly on the metal parts, but in a condition that fits its age. The previous owner checked the aperture ring, the focus ring and the aperture blades, and all of them work smoothly. The inside of the lens looks relatively clear by eye; because it is a used lens, minute dust may be present. A mount adapter is needed to use it on a mirrorless camera. It is a manual focus lens with no autofocus. Included, as shown in the photos: the lens only. Please see the photos for the exact condition.
vt1019070.why: A used Olympus OM-System G.Zuiko Auto-W 28mm f/3.5 manual focus lens.
vt1019070.perfect: Vintage lens fans who shoot landscapes and snapshots with OM lenses or adapt them to mirrorless cameras.
vt1019070.exp: A pre-owned Olympus G.Zuiko Auto-W 28mm f/3.5 in the condition described above.
vt1019070.cd: Pre-owned with age-related scuffs and small scratches, especially on the metal parts. Lens only, as shown in the photos. Please see photos and the listing description for full condition details.
